title: Article 132 — Appellate jurisdiction of the Supreme Court in appeals from High Courts in certain cases

content.study:
Topic at a Glance
Article 132 of the Constitution of India is titled “Appellate jurisdiction of the Supreme Court in appeals from High Courts in certain cases”. It forms an integral component of The Union (Articles 52–151), located within the “Union Judiciary” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.

Constitutional Text & Anatomy
(1) An appeal shall lie to the Supreme Court from any judgment, decree or final order of a High Court in the territory of India, whether in a civil, criminal or other proceeding, if the High Court certifies under article 134A that the case involves a substantial question of law as to the interpretation of this Constitution. .
